name: Puls8
description: Above the street, the water stays warm and the lights stay low. Puls8 is a rooftop lounge and pool for late hours: dark colors, neon accents, and a pool that looks better after midnight. High enough to feel private. Rough enough that you do not have to behave.

events.title: SPONGEBOB & FINAL FANTASY: MPREG RAVE?!
events.blurb:
Who let Bikini Bottom into Eorzea?!

Tonight, Puls8 is throwing the crossover nobody asked for but somehow absolutely needed. 

Expect questionable decisions, questionable outfits, and beats that go harder than they have any right to.

� THE VIBE
SpongeBob meets Eorzea

Zero explanation required

� Puls8 — Lavender Beds W7 P16
⏰ Tonight | 8 PM ST

Bring your weirdest glam. Bring your worst memes. Bring that one friend who needs professional internet supervision.

SHOW UP. GET WEIRD. TOUCH NO GRASS.
